description_verbatim: Restriction-site associated DNA (RAD/Paired-end RAD-Seq or ddRADseq) sequencing is a protocol used for SNP discovery and genotyping. In this method, genomic DNA is first digested with restriction enzymes, next barcoded adapters are added, DNA sheared, amplified and sequenced. Deep sequencing allows accurate SNP discovery and genotyping.

Deep sequencing allows accurate SNP discovery and genotyping.
